Class TabularDataException

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.lang.Throwable
      • java.lang.Exception
        • io.TabularDataException
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.io.Serializable

    public class TabularDataException
extends java.lang.Exception
    Represents a failure during tabular data or workbook read/write operations. Provides an TabularDataException.ErrorCode to categorise the failure and supports retaining an underlying cause for diagnostic purposes.
    Since:
    7 October 2026
    Version:
    0.1
    Author:
    Trevor Maggs
